name: What is the typical process for storm damage repair with Maine Results, Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for storm damage repair with Maine Results, Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our storm damage repair process begins with a detailed inspection to document all damage for both you and your insurance provider. We then provide a transparent estimate for the necessary repairs. Once approved, our team schedules and performs the repairs, focusing on restoring your property efficiently and to a high standard. A key part of our service is assisting you with the insurance claim process, ensuring all documentation is submitted correctly and promptly to facilitate smoother claim resolution.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves inspection, detailed estimate, repair scheduling, and completion, with assistance for your insurance claim.
